# Blewett

## Overview

## Appearance

Mrs. [Peter Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) is a small, sharp-faced woman with sharp eyes and a shrewish expression. She is exceptionally thin, lacking an ounce of superfluous flesh on her bones.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P13](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0013)_
